regression.countQualification: Same final C fixture; the number of evaluations changes because it enumerates every allocation fault until success. No semantic assertion or dimension was removed.

costs.heapQualification: Frame array capacity follows the configured maximum depth. XRT Calloc checks count*size and zeroes it. This increases per-depth heap metadata while removing per-depth native recursion.
costs.referenceCopyQualification: One allocation replaces the former two reference-name allocations. This does not imply all payload bytes/copies are halved or that returned text is zero-copy.
